**Bird Netting Trial Summary, 2024 Pinot Block**

This season we netted rows 1 to 20 of the Pinot block and left rows 21 to 40 unnetted as a control. At harvest on 25 September, the netted rows yielded 6.2 tonnes and the open rows yielded 5.6 tonnes.

It is important to note that the two groups are not directly comparable. The open rows sit on the lower slope, which experienced more frost in April. The yield difference may therefore reflect that growing condition rather than the effect of the netting, and the 0.6 tonne gap should not be read as a netting benefit.

Vineyard manager Claire Dubois assesses the trial as inconclusive. On the evidence from this single season, it is not possible to say whether the netting will pay for itself. A further trial, ideally with netted and open rows on comparable ground, would be needed before a firm conclusion can be drawn.
